metadata.article_title: Apportionment of relief or compensation obtained by such suits.

article.title: Apportionment of relief or compensation obtained by such suits.
article.content:
181Apportionment of relief or compensation obtained by such suits.

Section 181  ·  Chapter IX  ·  Suits by bailees or bailors against wrong-doers  ·  page 43 of the Act
Whatever is obtained by way of relief or compensation in any such suit shall, as between the bailor and the bailee, be dealt with according to their respective interests.
